# Thrill Wave

Thrill Wave is a Phoenix, Arizona video production and creative strategy company.

## Primary services
- Commercial and brand video production
- Documentary-style interviews and testimonials
- Commercial photography
- Research-led communications strategy through the SITREP process
- Campaign content and post-production

## Approach
Thrill Wave uses audience research and organizational context before production. Its SITREP process is organized around Ingest, Synthesize, and Execute.
